generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Record model calls, routes, users, tokens, cost, quota consumption, and policy decisions for audit and accounting.

contract.purpose_user_function: Record model invocation metadata for audit, usage visibility, and later routing/evaluation.
contract.valid_inputs: Pane/operator, provider/model, event/status, timestamps/duration, usage/tokens/cost where available, task/sprint/node IDs, and result metadata.
contract.expected_outputs: Structured model event appended to runtime telemetry/ledger and visible to status/reporting.
contract.state_side_effects: Appends event records and may update pane/runtime metadata; does not itself execute the model request.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Invalid/missing identifiers, unreadable pane metadata, absent usage fields, or write failure yields incomplete/error telemetry and must not invent usage.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Call/provider/model/status capture is shipped; consistent user identity, exact cost, quota consumption, and policy-decision accounting are partial.
contract.success_evidence: Event is correlated to task/pane/provider/model and preserves measured usage fields; runtime tests verify the record path.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: start/success/failure; provider/model normalization; token/cost present/absent; task correlation; duplicate event; write failure.
contract.readme_product_docs: README.md §What You Get and 'Choose or inspect models'; docs/solar-architecture-code-map.md §§2-4
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/model_registry.py: load_registry(), normalize(), spec(), main(); harness/lib/operator_model_selection.py: apply_model_selections(); harness/lib/model_call_runtime.py: record_model_event(), main(); README.md: solar harness models show/set-main
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Routes are configuration-driven; real calls depend on enabled local CLI/OAuth sessions or API keys, provider availability, model entitlement, local services, and quota.

implementation.interfaces: harness/lib/model_registry.py: load_registry(), normalize(), spec(), main(); harness/lib/operator_model_selection.py: apply_model_selections(); harness/lib/model_call_runtime.py: record_model_event(), main(); README.md: solar harness models show/set-main
